lesson.meaning: Something that is easy to do or use, suitable for your needs, and helps save time or effort.
examples: Online banking is very convenient because I can manage my money from home.
Could we schedule our team meeting for 2 PM? Would that be a convenient time for everyone?
The new office location is more convenient for most employees, as it's closer to the metro station.
Having all the project documents in one shared folder is very convenient for our team.
It's so convenient to have a coffee shop right next to our building for quick breaks.
lesson.memory_tip: Mama's Tip: If something makes your life easier or fits perfectly into your plans, it's 'convenient'!
